items.item_text: California Licensed Pharmacy Technician
Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) from the Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB)
Minimum education satisfied through attainment of the required licensure/certification
Recent Outpatient Pharmacy experience
Recent Outpatient Pharmacy experience
Experience in performing pharmacy calculations
Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) Pharmacy Technician experience
Experience in the use of pharmacy information systems and look-up of patient data on hospital information systems
Prior Authorization or Patient Assistance Program experience

The Pharmacy Technician 3 is responsible for gathering information from medical records and other sources as required to prepare and submit prior authorization requests and conduct benefit checks. Communicates on status of requests to requesting parties as appropriate and may work to resolve complex prior authorization requests. Maintains database of activities to document workload and impact on patient outcomes. #CA-DS
90% - Coordinates Prior Authorization submission workflow and facilitates medication access
10% - Data Analysis and Quality Improvement/Assurance Activities
Familiar with hospital layout, names and location of patient care areas and clinics.
Ability to prepare and submit Prior Authorization requests
Knowledge of Hospital, Department and University Policies and Procedures
Knowledge of current California Pharmacy Law
Ability to recognize situations that exceed technician authority and ability and must be referred to a pharmacist for resolution
Working knowledge of using an electronic medical record (EMR)
Demonstrated ability to be organized and to keep accurate records and pay close attention to details
Knowledge of generic and trade drug names and pharmacy terminology
Demonstrated ability to be self-motivated and work with minimal supervision, yet recognize when it is appropriate to seek assistance from others when limits of authority have been reached

Problem-solving skills to independently recognize and define a problem and identify the resources available to help solve the problem, create and implement viable solutions, and follow through to ensure the problem is resolved to the satisfaction of all parties.
Interpersonal skills to establish and maintain a friendly, welcoming environment for clinic's/department's customers
Excellent customer service skills and communication skills, both orally and in writing
